headline: Browns DT Maliek Collins lands 2-year extension worth $30 million, agent says
summary: The Browns and DT Maliek Collins have agreed to terms on a two-year, $30M extension that includes $23M guaranteed, his agent told ESPN and NFL Network.

headline: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson To Miss Week 7 With High Ankle Sprain, Expected To Return In Week 8
summary: OCTOBER 25: Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network (video link) says Jackson’s ailment is not a “typical” high ankle sprain but did not elaborate further on that point. Per Rapoport, Jackson was indeed “close” to playing against the Bengals and is expected to suit up for the Ravens’ matchup with the Bills in Week 8. […]

headline: NFL, NFLPA handling joint review of Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis
summary: The NFL and NFL Players Association are working together to review the handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis.

headline: Sources: Colts face big decisions on star players as NFL trade deadline looms
summary: The Colts are expected to field trade inquiries on some of their star players, including Jonathan Taylor, DeForest Buckner and Quenton Nelson.

headline: Rams optimistic that star WR Puka Nacua will play vs. Raiders, source says
summary: The Rams are optimistic that star wide receiver Puka Nacua will play Sunday against the Raiders, a source told ESPN.

headline: Eagles To Both Buy And Sell At Trade Deadline?
summary: The Eagles are 2-4 and are without their starting quarterback for the rest of the year. It therefore would be reasonable to expect them to operate as sellers at the upcoming trade deadline.
